An example of bootstrapped MAIHDA analysis

Source: R/bootstrapped_maihda.R
bootstrapped_maihda.Rd

A list as returned by calculate_partially_adjusted_maihda()

Usage

bootstrapped_maihda

Format

An object of class list of length 5.

Examples

# m <- MAIHDA::maihda(
#   Survived ~ Age + Sex + Class + (1 | Age:Sex:Class),
#   data = titanic,
#   family = binomial
# )
#
# bootstrapped_maihda <-
#   m |>
#   calculate_partially_adjusted_maihda(
#     bootstrap_pcv = TRUE,
#     bootstrap_vpc = TRUE
#   )

bootstrapped_maihda |>
  tbl_maihda(exponentiate = TRUE)
